sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:178067
Court No. - 82

Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 242 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Pooja Singh

Opposite Party :- Vivek Singh
Counsel for Applicant :- Ayyaz Khan,Shaheen Bano,Shahnawaz Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ram Mani Upadhyay,Sarvjeet Kumar
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Learned counsel for the opposite party, learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the record.

2.  This transfer application under section 407 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant (wife) with a prayer to allow the instant application and transfer the Case No.192 of 2022 (State Vs. Vivek Singh and Ors.) arising out of case crime no. 149/ 2022 under sections 323, 342, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Harriyya, District- Basti pending in the Court of Civil Judge (S.D.), Fast Track Court, Basti to a competent Court in District Sultanpur.

entities.text: Case No.192 of 2022 (State Vs. Vivek Singh and Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (S.D.), Fast Track Court, Basti
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Brief facts of the case are that the marriage of the applicant and opposite party no.2 was solemnized in the year 2017 according to Hindu rites and customs, but the family members (in-laws) as well as the opposite party no.2 were not happy with the dowry given in the marriage and were torturing and harassing the applicant in lieu of demand of additional dowry and was ousted from her matrimonial house due to demand of additional dowry.

Applicant filed an application u/s 12 of the Domestic Violence Act against the opposite party no.2 at Sultanpur, as she was residing Smt. Pooja Singh vs Vivek Singh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140363458/
1 with her father in Sultanpur.

entities.text: Pooja Singh vs Vivek Singh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that it is very difficult for the applicant to go the District Basti for the pairvee of the case.

Whenever she goes to contest the case at Basti,
opposite party uses to threaten her.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the opposite party vehemently opposed the prayer and it has been submitted that the applicant is not a house wife rather she is a police constable and presently posted at Barabanki and opposite party Vivek Singh is an employee in the India Army and at present he is posted at Punch, Kashmir.

It is further submitted that applicant has no problem to visit to Sultanpur for the parivee of the case because district Barabanki where she is posted at present is not too far from Basti.
6.

In the matrimonial matters, the convenience of wife and in particular that she has no one in her family to escort her to undertake a long journey has been held to be good ground for transfer of case as is also evident from Hon'ble Apex Court's decision in Anjali Ashok Sadhwani vs. Ashok Kishinchand Sadhwani, AIR 2009 SC 1374 and Fatema vs. Jafri Syed Husain @ Syed Parvez Jafferi,
AIR 2009 SC 1773.
7. Convenience of wife to pursue the proceedings is a relevant factor if pleaded bona fide for justifying transfer of a matter to the place where it is convenient to the wife.

sentences.text: Looking to the facts of the case, as stated above, I am of the view that it is in the interest of justice that the instant transfer application should be allowed.
8. In view of the above, the present transfer application is allowed.
9. Let the Case No.
Case No. 192 of 2022 (State Vs. Vivek Singh and Ors.) arising out of case crime no. 149/ 2022 under sections 323, 342, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Harriyya, District- Basti
